name: Sarvam-105B-1711
archDisplay: 105B MoE transformer (~10.3B active/token) with Multi-head Latent Attention; updated post-training of Sarvam-105B, shipped as NVFP4 and BF16 weights
note: Sarvam AI's November 22, 2026 update to Sarvam-105B: the same 105B/10.3B-active MoE with new post-training, released as Apache-2.0 open weights (NVFP4 at sarvamai/sarvam-105b-1711, BF16 at sarvamai/sarvam-105b-1711-bf16). The API ids sarvam-105b and sarvam-105b-conversations now serve these weights. Context is 160K per the launch blog (the card's evals ran at 131,072). Price is left null: Sarvam lists INR only (₹10 input / ₹25 output per Mtok on Token Factory). Rows are the card's BF16 column, all self-run in thinking mode at temperature 1.0. Not filed as non-standard settings: IFEval 96.5 (sampled mean@4; the official setting is greedy), IFBench 82.5 (prompt-level strict, mean@8), HLE 12.3 (GPT-4.1 judge), Arena-Hard v2 76.6 (no style control), τ²-Bench 85.5 and τ³ Banking 19.8 (GPT-5.2 user simulator). Not filed for lack of a column: BFCL v4 62.4, MultiChallenge 62.2, WritingBench 86.5, HMMT, AIME 2026 89.7, and the internal GDPval-S and Indic Suite.
